## import apple sunburn results
```{r}
# Set APPLE_APV_DATA_ROOT to the supplementary-data directory when data are
# stored outside this repository. Otherwise, use the repository root.
working_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = FALSE)
repo_root <- if (basename(working_root) == "R" && basename(dirname(working_root)) == "scripts") {
  normalizePath(file.path(working_root, "../.."), mustWork = FALSE)
} else {
  working_root
}
base_folder <- Sys.getenv("APPLE_APV_DATA_ROOT", unset = repo_root)
base_folder <- normalizePath(base_folder, mustWork = FALSE)

saveToFolder <- file.path(base_folder, "outputs", "sunburnDaysFigures")

data_scen <- "AWN" ## based on locations

## IMPORT LOCATION DATA
if(data_scen == "NSRDB"){
  ## import old results to get the lat/longs of the 10 NSRDB locations
  results_latLong_df <- read_csv(file.path(base_folder, "sunburn_results", "sunburn_risk_hours.csv")) %>% select(station, lat, long) %>%
    unique()  
}
if(data_scen == "AWN"){
  results_latLong_df <- read_csv(file.path(base_folder, "site_locations", "Loc56.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
    mutate(station = as.numeric(str_sub(filename, -10, -5))) %>%
    select(fid, station, lat, long, "exclude?")
}


results_NSRDB_df <- read_csv(file.path(base_folder, "sunburn_results", "sunburn_hours_day_56_NSRDB.csv")) %>% # sunburn_hours_day_56_NSRDB.csv OR sunburn_hours_day_10_NSRDB_flatapple.csv OR sunburn_hours_day_10_NSRDB_trackingapple.csv
  separate(sensitivity_category, into = c("control_variant", "windspeed"), sep = "_", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(windspeed = case_when(control_variant == "Baseline" | control_variant == "Control" ~ "0",
                               .default = windspeed), 
         control_variant = case_when(control_variant == "V1" ~ "Agrivoltaic designs",
                             control_variant == "Baseline" ~ "Baseline",
                             control_variant == "C" ~ "Unshaded control",
                             control_variant == "Control" ~ "Unshaded control",
                             .default = control_variant),
      variants = case_when(variants == "Fixed - ThickHats" ~ "EW Dual-Tilt - High Density",
                             variants == "Fixed - ThinHats" ~ "EW Dual-Tilt - Medium Density",
                           variants == "Tracking - HighDensity" ~ "Tracking - High Density",
                           variants == "Tracking - Low Density" ~ "Tracking - Medium Density",
                           variants == "Tracking - LowestShade" ~ "Tracking - Low Density",
                             .default = variants),
      data_scenario = "NSRDB") %>%
  filter(control_variant != "Baseline")
  
results_AWN_df <- read_csv(file.path(base_folder, "sunburn_results", "sunburn_hours_day_56_AWN.csv")) %>% # sunburn_hours_day_56_AWN.csv
  separate(sensitivity_category, into = c("control_variant", "windspeed"), sep = "_", fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(windspeed = case_when(control_variant == "Baseline" | control_variant == "Control" ~ "0",
                               .default = windspeed), 
         control_variant = case_when(control_variant == "V1" ~ "Agrivoltaic designs",
                             control_variant == "Baseline" ~ "Baseline",
                             control_variant == "C" ~ "Unshaded control",
                             control_variant == "Control" ~ "Unshaded control",
                             .default = control_variant),
      variants = case_when(variants == "Fixed - ThickHats" ~ "EW Dual-Tilt - High Density",
                             variants == "Fixed - ThinHats" ~ "EW Dual-Tilt - Medium Density",
                           variants == "Tracking - HighDensity" ~ "Tracking - High Density",
                           variants == "Tracking - LowDensity" ~ "Tracking - Medium Density",
                           variants == "Tracking - LowestShade" ~ "Tracking - Low Density",
                             .default = variants),
      data_scenario = "AgWeatherNet") %>%
  filter(control_variant != "Baseline")
  
## Combine AWN and NSRDB data
results_df <- rbind(results_NSRDB_df, results_AWN_df)

## save to csv:
#write_csv(results_df, "sunburn_results_df.csv")
```


```{r}
# Step 2: Create full grid of all combinations
full_grid <- expand_grid(
  station = unique(results_df$station),
  Year = unique(results_df$Year),
  Month = 5:10,  # assuming May–Sept as valid months
  variants = unique(results_df$variants),
  control_variant = unique(results_df$control_variant),
  windspeed = unique(results_df$windspeed),
  data_scenario = unique(results_df$data_scenario)
)

# Step 3: Join and fill missing rows
results_df_complete <- full_grid %>%
  left_join(results_df, by = c("station", "Year", "Month", "variants", "control_variant", "windspeed", "data_scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    number_days = replace_na(number_days, 0),
    number_hours = replace_na(number_hours, 0)
  )


```

```{r}

## Create df with annual average sunburn days

# Step 1: Summarize results_df_complete to annual total sunburn days
total_annual_days <- results_df_complete %>%
  group_by(station, Year, variants, control_variant, windspeed, data_scenario) %>%
  summarize(
    total_days = sum(number_days),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: Average over years to get annual average sunburn days
mean_annual_by_group <- total_annual_days %>%
  group_by(station, variants, control_variant, windspeed, data_scenario) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_annual_sunburn_days = mean(total_days),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## get only agrivoltaic designs
mean_annual_by_group_APV <- mean_annual_by_group %>% 
  filter(control_variant == "Agrivoltaic designs")

## get only one set of controls
mean_annual_by_group_control <-mean_annual_by_group %>% 
  filter(control_variant == "Unshaded control" & variants == "EW Dual-Tilt - High Density") %>%
  mutate(variants = "Unshaded control")

## combine control and apv designs
sunburnDays_byStation_combined <- rbind(mean_annual_by_group_APV,mean_annual_by_group_control)



## CALCULATE % REDUCTION IN SUNBURN DAYS

# Step 1: Create a reference table for Control at windspeed == 0
total_annual_days_control_ref <- total_annual_days %>%
  #st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(control_variant == "Unshaded control" & variants == "EW Dual-Tilt - High Density") %>%
  select(-variants, control_days = total_days)

# Step 2: Join control values to full dataset
total_annual_days_with_ref <- total_annual_days %>%
  filter(control_variant != "Unshaded control") %>%  # exclude control itself from results
  left_join(total_annual_days_control_ref, by = c("station", "Year", "windspeed", "data_scenario"))

# Step 3: Calculate percent reduction
reduction_df <- total_annual_days_with_ref %>%
  mutate(perc_reduction = 100 * (control_days - total_days) / control_days) %>%
  select(station, Year, windspeed, variants, perc_reduction, data_scenario) %>%
  group_by(station, windspeed, variants, data_scenario) %>%
  summarize(avg_perc_reduction = mean(perc_reduction, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


## Drop the 7 locations that aren't really orchard locations:
stations_drop <- results_latLong_df %>%
  filter(`exclude?` == "yes") %>%
  pull(station)

sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped <- sunburnDays_byStation_combined %>%
  filter(!(station %in% stations_drop))
```

## make scatterplot of AWN Vs. NSRDB comparison
```{r}
## pivot wider so that AWN and NSRDB are in their own columns
sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped_wide <- sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = data_scenario,
    values_from = avg_annual_sunburn_days
  )

unique(sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped_wide$variants)

p_scatter <- sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped_wide %>%
  filter(windspeed %in% c("WS10", "WS20", "WS30")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = AgWeatherNet, y = NSRDB, color = windspeed)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "BuGn") + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +  # 1:1 reference line
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "AgWeatherNet - annual average sunburn days",
    y = "NSRDB - annual average sunburn days",
    title = "Annual average sunburn days across 49 sites"
  ) + 
  #xlim(0,30) + ylim(0, 30) +
  facet_wrap(~variants, scales = "free") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(saveToFolder, "apple_sunburnDays_scatter_flatApples_49NSRDBvAWN.pdf"), p_scatter, width = 8, height = 5, units = "in")
```

## Make boxplot of sunburn days - annual average
windspeed on x axis, with AWN and NSRDB groups (colors), variants (including control) in facets

```{r}
p_box <- sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(windspeed), y = avg_annual_sunburn_days, fill = data_scenario)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wes_palette(n = length(unique(sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped$data_scenario)), name = "Darjeeling2")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Percent wind speed reduction",
    y = "Annual average sunburn days"
    #title = "Annual average sunburn days across 49 sites"
  ) + 
  #xlim(0,30) + ylim(0, 30) +
  facet_wrap(~variants, scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(saveToFolder, "apple_sunburnDays_boxplot_flatApples_49NSRDBvAWN.pdf"), p_box, width = 8, height = 5, units = "in")
```

## Make boxplot of % difference in annual average sunburn days between AWN and NSRDB
```{r}
p_box_diff <- sunburnDays_byStation_combined_dropped_wide %>%
  mutate(diff = 100* (NSRDB - AgWeatherNet)/NSRDB) %>%
  filter(variants != "EW Dual-Tilt - High Density") %>%
ggplot(aes(x = factor(windspeed), y = diff)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Percent wind speed reduction",
    y = "Percent difference in annual average \nsunburn days (NSRDB vs. AWN) (%)"
    #title = "Annual average sunburn days across 49 sites"
  ) + 
  #xlim(0,30) + ylim(0, 30) +
  facet_wrap(~variants, scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(saveToFolder, "apple_sunburnDays_boxplot_flatApples_49NSRDBvAWN_percentDiff.pdf"), p_box_diff, width = 8, height = 5, units = "in")
```

## Make boxplot of sunburn days - monthly averages
months on x axis, with AWN and NSRDB groups (colors), variants (including control) in facets
```{r}
# Step 1: Summarize results_df_complete to monthly average sunburn days
avg_monthly_days <- results_df_complete %>%
  group_by(station, Month, variants, control_variant, windspeed, data_scenario) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_number_days = mean(number_days),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## get only agrivoltaic designs
avg_monthly_days_APV <- avg_monthly_days %>% 
  filter(control_variant == "Agrivoltaic designs")

## get only one set of controls
avg_monthly_days_control <- avg_monthly_days %>% 
  filter(control_variant == "Unshaded control" & variants == "EW Dual-Tilt - High Density") %>%
  mutate(variants = "Unshaded control")

## combine control and apv designs
avg_monthly_days_combined <- rbind(avg_monthly_days_APV,avg_monthly_days_control)



p_box_monthly <- avg_monthly_days_combined %>%
  filter(windspeed == "0") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = data_scenario, y = avg_number_days)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Percent wind speed reduction",
    y = "Annual average sunburn days")+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(variants), cols = vars(Month), scales = "free") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(saveToFolder, "apple_sunburnDays_boxplot_flatApples_49NSRDBvAWN.pdf"), p_box, width = 8, height = 5, units = "in")

```
